DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人の指定席を確認したいです。私が通路側を希望しましたが、この番号のどちらが通路側でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人の指定席で本人希望の通路側番号を照会する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to check our two reserved seats. I requested the aisle; which of these numbers is the aisle seat?
DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese which of two reserved seat numbers is the aisle seat you requested.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この列車の座席図で確認しましょう。お二人の席は同じ列ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check this train's seating plan. Are your seats in the same row?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ列のAとBです。文字が後だからBが窓側だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同列ABで後文字Bを窓側と誤解したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: A and B in the same row. I thought B was the window because it comes later in the alphabet.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your seats are A and B in one row and you mistakenly thought B, the later letter, was the window.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この座席図ではAが窓、Bが通路です。ほかの列車も同じと決めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: On this seating plan, A is the window and B is the aisle. Please don't assume other trains are the same.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では私はBですね。連れも自分の番号を見て、どちらへ座るか確認してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 図でB本人通路を確認し同行者にも番号照合を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'm in B. I'll ask my companion to check their own number and confirm where to sit too.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm from the diagram in Japanese that B is your aisle seat and ask your companion to compare their number too.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 乗車前にお二人で相談できます。別の方の席へは座らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can discuss it together before boarding. Please don't sit in someone else's seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 連れが窓側を希望しているので、この二席のままでよいと二人で決めました。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行者窓希望で現二席のままと双方合意したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: My companion wants the window, so we've both agreed to keep these two seats.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you both agreed to retain the two seats because your companion wants the window.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その内容なら各自の券と座席図を確認して乗れます。号車もお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then you can board after checking each ticket against the seating plan. Please also check the car number.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: Aの連れは窓側、Bの私は通路側で、号車も合わせてから乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 列車の図に合うAB位置と号車を照合して乗ると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: My companion in A has the window, and I in B have the aisle. We'll match the car number too before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat in Japanese the A and B positions matching this train's plan and that you will check the car before boarding.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。指定の号車へお気をつけてご乗車ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please board your designated car carefully.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 追加の皿が届きました。この鍋へ全部入れて、すぐ食べてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 卓上鍋の追加皿を全投入して即食べられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: The additional plate has arrived. Can I put everything into this tabletop pot and eat it straight away?
DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you may put the whole additional plate in the tabletop pot and eat immediately.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 追加の皿はまだ調理が必要な物です。こちらで入れる順と食べられる状態をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-03.translation: The additional plate still needs cooking. We'll explain the order to add the ingredients and when they are ready to eat.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 最初の鍋は食べていたので、追加の皿もそのまま食べられると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最初の調理済み鍋と追加皿を同状態と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: Since I was already eating the first pot, I thought the additional plate was ready to eat as it was too.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you thought the cooked first pot and the additional plate were in the same condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 先に出た料理と追加皿は状態が違います。いまは追加分を箸で取らずお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-05.translation: The first dish and additional plate are in different states. For now, please wait without taking any of the additional portion with your chopsticks.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: わかりました。最初の料理の残りと追加分を混ぜて、どれか分からなくしないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 既調理の残りと追加分を混ぜず区別保持すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I'll avoid mixing the cooked leftovers with the additional portion so I don't lose track of which is which.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will keep the cooked remainder separate from the added portion so they remain identifiable.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらで追加の準備をします。火の調整も店員へお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll prepare the additional portion. Please also ask staff if you need the heat adjusted.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分で火を強くせず、準備が済んだか確認してから食べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人で加熱操作せず職員の準備完了を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't turn up the heat myself, and will check that preparation is complete before eating.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not adjust the heat yourself and want to confirm staff have finished preparing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。できましたらお知らせします。取り分け用の道具はこちらをお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. We'll let you know when it's ready. Please use these utensils for sharing.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 未調理の追加皿は先に食べず、店員さんの案内を待って取り分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未調理追加分を食べず職員案内後に専用具で取り分けると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't eat the uncooked additional plate first; I'll wait for the staff's instructions before serving it out.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat in Japanese that you will not eat the uncooked addition and will use the designated utensils after staff guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらで準備しますので、少々お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-19-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll prepare it, so please wait a moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 車の窓が泥で見えにくそうです。待っている間に、私が拭いておきましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 待機中に泥付き作業車窓を拭く手伝いを申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: The vehicle's window looks hard to see through because of mud. Shall I wipe it while we're waiting?
DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Offer in Japanese to help wipe a muddy work-vehicle window while waiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その車両は担当が管理しています。作業の指示なしで近づかないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: That vehicle is managed by the person responsible. Please don't approach without work instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私は今日は見学者です。掃除なら作業に含まれないと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人見学者で清掃は作業外と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm a visitor today. I thought cleaning wouldn't count as work.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you are a visitor and thought cleaning was outside the work restriction.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 車両へ触れることも担当の確認が必要です。気づいた状態を伝えるだけにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: Touching the vehicle also requires confirmation from the person responsible. Please only report the condition you noticed.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: タオルを出す前なので、車には触っていません。前の窓に泥が付いていると知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: タオル未使用で車両未接触かつ前窓泥付着を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: I haven't taken out a towel yet, so I haven't touched the vehicle. I'll report that there is mud on the front window.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that you have not used a towel or touched the vehicle and there is mud on the front window.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。現場担当へ連絡します。待機位置から離れずお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. We'll contact the site staff. Please wait without leaving the waiting position.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 窓の近くへ歩いて示すのでなく、ここから見える車を言葉で説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 窓へ近づかず指定待機位置から車を言葉で示すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: Rather than walk near the window to point it out, I'll describe the vehicle visible from here in words.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will identify the vehicle verbally from the designated waiting position without approaching the window.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。車両が動く場合もありますので、指定の待機位置を守ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Vehicles may also move, so please stay in the designated waiting position.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見学者として待ち、車両の清掃を自分で始めず担当へ状態だけ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 見学者待機を守り清掃せず状態のみ担当へ知らせると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait as a visitor and only tell the person responsible about the condition, without beginning to clean the vehicle myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat in Japanese that you will stay in the visitor waiting area and report the condition without cleaning.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。見学担当が来るまでこちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for cooperating. Please wait here until the tour supervisor arrives.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社から立替分の返金予定が来ました。口座にはまだ見えませんが、受け取ったと報告してよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社返金予定連絡があるが口座未表示で受領報告可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: My company sent a notice about a planned reimbursement of money I paid upfront. I can't see it in my account yet; may I report that I've received it?
DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can report receipt when the company has notified a planned reimbursement but it is not yet visible in the account.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予定の連絡と口座で確認できる記録は分けてください。どの記録を見ていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please distinguish the planned-payment notice from records you can confirm in the account. Which record are you looking at?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日の取引一覧です。会社のメールには今日送る予定とあり、完了という言葉はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本日取引一覧と会社の本日実行予定メールを区別して説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: Today's transaction list. The company email says they plan to send it today, and doesn't say “completed.”
DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish today's transaction list from the company's planned-payment email in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらでは会社が送ったかをそのメールだけで確認できません。本人の入金記録を担当へ照会できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can't confirm from that email alone whether the company sent it. You can ask the person responsible to check your own deposit record.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 予定のメールを受取済みの証拠にしません。会社には、手続きが完了したかを先に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予定通知を受領証拠にせず会社へ実行完了を照会すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't use the planned-payment email as proof of receipt. I'll ask the company first whether the procedure has been completed.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not treat the plan notice as proof of receipt and will ask the company whether execution is complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。対象の額や口座を確認する場合も、相手の実行情報と別に整理できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. When checking the amount and account too, you can organize that separately from the sender's execution information.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ほかの入金はありますが、立替分の額とは違います。それを返金と決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別額の入金を対象返金と決めつけないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: There are other deposits, but they differ from the reimbursement amount. I won't assume they are that reimbursement.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not assume a deposit for a different amount is the reimbursement in question.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当と記録を照合してから、確認できた状況を会社へ伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: After comparing the record with the person responsible, tell the company what status you could confirm.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 返金予定は連絡済み、受取は未確認として伝えます。照合後に入金の有無を改めて報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予定連絡あり受領未確認を報告し口座照合後に実受領を知らせると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll report that I received the reimbursement plan notice but receipt of the funds is unconfirmed. After comparison, I'll report again whether it was deposited.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat in Japanese that you will report notification received but funds unconfirmed, and report actual receipt after checking the account.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。対象の記録を担当窓口でご相談ください。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please discuss the relevant record at the appropriate counter. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どうされましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 折り畳み自転車を列車で運びたいのですが、この袋に入りきりません。乗る前に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自転車が運搬袋に入りきらず乗車前の相談をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to carry a folding bicycle on the train, but it doesn't fit fully in this bag. I'd like advice before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for advice before boarding because your bicycle does not fully fit its carrying bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋の状態を見せてください。どの部分が外へ出ていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me the bag's condition. Which part sticks out?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 車輪の下の部分です。自転車は畳みましたが、友人から借りた袋が小さかったようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 折畳み済みだが借りた袋が小さく車輪下部が出ると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The lower part of the wheel. I've folded the bicycle, but the bag I borrowed from a friend seems too small.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the bicycle is folded but the borrowed bag is small and the lower wheel sticks out.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この状態で運べると判断せず、取扱いを係員と確認しましょう。まだ改札へは入っていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Rather than decide it's acceptable like this, let's check handling requirements with a staff member. You haven't entered the ticket gates yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、まだです。布を掛けるだけで済ませず、この自転車に合う袋を用意し直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 改札前で布を掛ける代用ではなく適合する袋を用意したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Correct. Rather than just cover it with cloth, I'd like to get a bag that fits this bicycle.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you are outside the gates and want a suitable bag rather than substitute a cloth covering.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 準備後に、大きさなどの利用条件も確認できます。今日の移動予定はどうされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: After preparing, you can also check conditions such as size. What will you do about today's travel plans?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 次の列車に乗る予定でしたが、準備を優先します。友人に到着が遅れると連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予定列車より準備を優先し友人へ遅れると連絡すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I planned to take the next train, but I'll prioritize preparing it. I'll tell my friend that I'll arrive late.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will prioritize preparation over your planned train and tell your friend you will be delayed.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。袋を替えたら、自転車全体が収まっているかと利用条件を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. After changing bags, please check that the entire bicycle is inside and confirm the usage conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人へ連絡して、いったん袋を用意し直します。収まった状態を係員へ見せてから乗車を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 袋を用意し直し収まった状態と利用条件を係員へ確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll contact my friend and get a suitable bag first. After showing staff that it fits inside, I'll ask about boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will replace the bag and ask staff to check the fully enclosed bicycle and usage conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。準備ができましたら、また係員へお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Once you're ready, please speak to a staff member again.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受付でお手伝いできることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there anything reception can help you with?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この呼出し端末を受け取りました。音が小さく感じるので、呼ばれた時に気づけるか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 呼出し端末の音が小さく気づけるか心配と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've received this pager. The sound seems quiet, so I'm worried I won't notice when I'm called.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about concern that the pager's quiet sound may make the call hard to notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 呼出し方法を確認します。この端末は、まだ鞄に入れていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check how it calls you. You haven't put it in your bag yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、手に持っています。音だけでは気づきにくいので、振動もあるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未収納で手に持ち音以外に振動があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Correct, I'm holding it. Sound alone is hard for me to notice, so I'd like to know whether it vibrates too.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you are holding it, not storing it, and ask whether it vibrates as well as makes sound.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当と確認して、試しの呼出しをしてみます。端末を持ったままお待ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check with the person responsible and try a test call. Could you wait while holding the device?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。今、振動が分かりました。鞄の奥に入れると気づかないかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 試しの振動に気づいたが鞄の奥では気づきにくいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I noticed the vibration just now. If I put it deep inside my bag, I might miss it.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you noticed the test vibration but might not notice it deep in your bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ではご自身が気づきやすい持ち方でお待ちください。表示の番号も読めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then please wait holding it in a way you can easily notice. Can you also read the displayed number?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 読めます。この番号が出た時に、案内された受付へ行くという理解で合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 読める番号の表示後に案内受付へ行く理解を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Am I correct that when this number appears, I should go to the reception desk you've indicated?
DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you can read the number and should go to the indicated reception when it appears.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その案内です。試しの表示は実際の順番の呼出しではありません。消してからお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: That's the instruction. The test display isn't your actual turn being called. Please clear it and wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今の試しでは移動せず、端末を手元に持って実際の呼出しを待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 試験表示では移動せず手元で本番の呼出しを待つと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I won't move for this test; I'll keep the device close at hand and wait for the actual call.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not move for the test display and will wait with the pager at hand for the actual call.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。待つ間に端末が動かなくなったら、受付へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. If the device stops working while you wait, please tell reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。セルフレジでお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you having trouble with the self-checkout?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 表示を読みやすい言語に変えたら、商品の一覧が見えなくなりました。もう一度全部読み取る必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 言語変更後商品一覧が見えず全品再登録が必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: After changing the display to a language I can read more easily, the item list disappeared. Do I need to scan everything again?
DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether all items need re-registering because the list disappeared after a language change.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そのままお待ちください。お支払いはまだでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please wait as it is. You haven't paid yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。牛乳とパンを先に読み取りましたが、今は画面に言語の選択が出ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 支払前で牛乳とパン登録後に言語選択画面が出ていると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I scanned milk and bread first, but the screen now shows language selection.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have not paid, scanned milk and bread, and now see the language selection screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 言語選択から商品画面へ戻して、登録が残っているか確認しましょう。追加で読み取らずお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's return from language selection to the item screen and check whether registration remains. Please wait without scanning again.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。今戻ると、牛乳とパンが一つずつあります。登録は消えていなかったのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 商品画面へ戻ると二品各一つが残っていると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Now we're back, there is one milk and one bread. So the registration hadn't disappeared.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that returning to the item screen shows one each of the two products still registered.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二品が残っています。まだ登録していない物もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The two items remain. Is there anything you haven't registered yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 卵が残っています。さきほどの二品はそのままにして、卵だけ追加したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未登録の卵だけ追加し先の二品の登録を維持したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: The eggs remain. I'd like to keep the first two as they are and add only the eggs.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to add only the unregistered eggs while preserving the first two entries.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 追加後に、商品名と個数を一覧で見てから会計へ進んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: After adding them, check the product names and quantities in the list before proceeding to payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三品とも一つずつになりました。この一覧を確認してから支払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三品各一つの一覧を確認して会計へ進むと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: All three items are listed once each. I'll check this list before paying.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will confirm one each of the three items in the list before proceeding to payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。画面で支払い方法を選んでください。お困りでしたらまたお呼びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please select your payment method on screen. Call us again if you need help.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: コピー機の原稿台に、誰かの紙が残っています。自分の原稿を置く前に気づいたので、お知らせしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: コピー前に原稿台の他人の紙を見つけ店員へ知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Someone's paper is left on the copier's document glass. I noticed before placing my own original and wanted to tell you.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Tell staff in Japanese that you found someone else's paper on the copier glass before copying.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。残っていた紙を取り出しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you. Have you removed the paper that was left?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ置いたままです。内容を読むために開いたのではなく、原稿台を使おうとして見つけました。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未回収で内容を読むためでなく利用前に見つけたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's still there. I didn't open it to read the contents; I found it when I was going to use the document glass.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have not removed it and found it before using the machine, not to read it.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 店員が確認してお預かりします。ご自身の書類は別にお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: A staff member will check and hold it. Are you keeping your own documents separately?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、自分の書類はこの封筒の中です。残った紙と一緒にコピーはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の書類は封筒内で残った原稿と混ぜてコピーしていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, my documents are in this envelope. I haven't copied them together with the paper left behind.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your documents are in an envelope and you have not copied them mixed with the previous original.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらでお預かりしました。機械には、前の方の操作画面も残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We've collected it. Is the previous person's operation screen still on the machine too?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 部数を選ぶ画面が出ています。前の設定をそのまま使わず、最初から自分の操作を始めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 前利用者の部数設定画面を引き継がず初期画面から操作したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It shows the number-of-copies selection. Rather than use the previous settings, I'd like to start my own operation from the initial screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to start from the initial screen rather than inherit the previous user's copy-count settings.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 初期画面へ戻す方法をご案内します。ご自身の原稿を置いたら、最後に取り忘れないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll explain how to return to the initial screen. Once you put down your original, please remember to collect it at the end.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 初期画面から一部をコピーします。終わったら、自分の原稿とコピーを取って原稿台も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一部コピー後に原稿とコピーを回収し原稿台を確認すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll make one copy from the initial screen. After finishing, I'll collect my original and copy and check the document glass too.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that after one copy you will collect both original and copy and check the glass.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。残った紙を知らせてくださり、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for telling us about the paper left behind.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何についてご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to ask about?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 机の回収を申し込みたいです。脚を外したら五つに分かれたので、申込みの品数も五つになるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 机一台を分解して五部品になり回収申込み品数も五つか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to arrange collection of a desk. Removing the legs separated it into five parts; does that also mean five items on the application?
DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether one desk dismantled into five components counts as five collection items.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 机一台を分解したのですね。ほかの家具の部品も混ざっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: You dismantled one desk, correct? Are parts from other furniture mixed in too?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 机一台だけです。天板が一枚と脚が四本で、椅子や別の机はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 天板一枚と脚四本で他家具の部品は混ざらないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only one desk. One tabletop and four legs; there are no chairs or other desks.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that it is one top and four legs with no other furniture parts mixed in.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その状態を回収担当へ伝えて確認しましょう。部品が分かる写真はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's tell the collection staff about that condition and check. Do you have a photograph showing the parts?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: あります。別々の家具五台ではなく、元の机一台の部品だと分かるように、全体を並べて撮りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 元の机一台の部品と分かるよう全体を並べた写真を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I arranged all the parts together for the photo so it's clear they are from one original desk, not five different pieces of furniture.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the photo with the parts arranged together and explain in Japanese that they belong to one original desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真と、それぞれの大きさも確認できるようにしてください。回収の申込みはまだですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also make each part's size available along with the photo. Have you not applied for collection yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。天板の縦と横は測りました。脚も測ってから、まとめ方と品数を担当へ聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未申込みで天板寸法は測定済みと伝え脚測定後にまとめ方と品数を尋ねたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. I've measured the top's length and width. After measuring the legs too, I'd like to ask the staff how to bundle them and count the items.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have not applied, the top is measured, and you will measure the legs before asking about bundling and item count.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分解後の状態に合う案内を確認してから申込みましょう。今ここで回収日が決まったわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's apply after checking instructions appropriate to the dismantled condition. No collection date has been decided here now.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。机一台の五部品と説明して、寸法と写真を示します。数え方と出し方を聞いてから申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 元の机一台五部品の寸法と写真を示し数え方と出し方確認後申込みすると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll explain it's five parts from one desk and show measurements and the photo. I'll apply after asking how to count and put it out.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will show the dimensions and photo of one desk's five parts and apply after confirming counting and disposal methods.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。回収の相談担当へご案内します。写真のメモもお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll show you to the collection adviser. Please bring the photo notes too.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。郵便について何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with the post?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この招待状は、昨日料金を聞いて切手を貼りました。そのあと飾りを入れたので、出す前にもう一度見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 料金確認と切手貼付後に飾りを追加した招待状を再確認依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yesterday I asked the postage for this invitation and put on stamps. Then I added a decoration; could you check it again before I send it?
DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for another check of an invitation after adding a decoration following a postage check and stamp attachment.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 追加した物も入った、今の封筒ですね。昨日と比べてどこが変わりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is the envelope in its current state, including the addition, correct? What has changed since yesterday?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 厚い紙の花を一枚入れました。外からは分かりませんが、前より厚くなっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 厚い紙の花一枚を追加して前より厚くなったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I added one thick paper flower. You can't see it from outside, but it's thicker than before.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that adding one thick paper flower made it thicker than before.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では現在の状態で重さや大きさを確認します。封はもう閉じていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then we'll check the weight and dimensions in its current condition. Have you already sealed it?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。このまま送る内容がそろっています。昨日聞いた料金だけで足りるとは思わず、今の状態を見てほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 封済みで送る内容が確定し以前の料金で足りると決めず現状態を確認依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Everything I intend to send is in it. I don't assume yesterday's postage is enough; I'd like you to check it as it is now.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that it is sealed with all intended contents and request a current check without assuming the old postage is sufficient.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認します。切手を貼った後に内容を足すと、条件が変わることがあります。ほかの封筒もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check. Adding contents after attaching stamps can change the conditions. Do you have other envelopes too?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: もう二通ありますが、そちらには飾りを入れていません。同じ料金とまとめず、別に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 追加二通は飾りなしで同料金とまとめず別確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Two more, but I haven't added decorations to those. I'd like them checked separately rather than grouped as the same postage.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that two more envelopes have no decorations and you want separate checks rather than assuming equal postage.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 三通の状態をそれぞれ確認し、必要な料金をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check each of the three envelopes and explain the postage needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。飾り入りの一通と、入れていない二通を分けて確認し、料金がそろってから出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 飾り一通と飾りなし二通の条件と料金を確認後差し出すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll check the decorated one separately from the two without decorations, and send them after the postage is correct.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will confirm the conditions and postage for the one decorated and two undecorated envelopes before posting.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まずこちらの一通から確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll start by checking this one.
